calls.video_title: Interesting News for Walmart Stock Investors | WMT Stock Analysis
calls.thesis: Bundled Walmart Plus + Sam's Club Plus ($120/yr) is a good value move against Costco/Amazon, but the stock is too rich to buy here; hold conviction downgraded high -> medium and approaching a sell.
calls.base_case: Hold long-term could still give a reasonable return, but confidence is falling.
calls.bull_case: Bundle drives significant consumer adoption; e-commerce/marketplace gains continue.
calls.bear_case: Same-store sales growth slowest since 2020 (+2.6%); 36.5x forward P/E compresses; downgrade to SELL if overvaluation persists.

calls.video_title: Should Investors Buy Costco Stock Instead of Walmart Stock? | COST Stock Analysis WMT Stock Analysis
calls.thesis: Loses the head-to-head vs Costco — DCF says ~36% overvalued despite excellent e-commerce execution.
calls.base_case: DCF fair value $70; consistent with his prior WMT AVOID — no flip.
calls.bull_case: E-commerce scale and ad/marketplace mix could lift 4.4% margins structurally.
calls.bear_case: Rich 34x forward P/E compresses on any growth wobble.

calls.video_title: Walmart Has Arguably Been the Best E-Commerce Business in Recent Years | WMT Stock Analysis
calls.thesis: Business thriving and beating Amazon on logistics, but forward PE 34 is rich for a retailer with 4.3% operating margins; DCF says overvalued.
calls.base_case: DCF fair value $70, ~36% below market price.
calls.bull_case: Third-party marketplace + advertising growth could lift margins toward Amazon-like levels.
calls.bear_case: Margin recovery stalls; rich multiple compresses on any growth wobble.

calls.bear: Not a tech-style compounder; retail is Brian's weakest circle.
